text: **Answer:** Yes. The asset experienced tree-cover loss events after 2020, totaling 87.4 ha (2.4% of the asset). The largest event (81.3 ha) occurred in 2021, with smaller events in 2022 (0.6 ha) and 2023 (4.5 ha). All events met the corroboration rule, as the JRC 2020 reference confirmed ≥50% of the event areas as forest. The 2021 event alone exceeds the 0.5-ha minimum threshold for reporting.
